_about: Open structured data layer (src/open_data/). Per dataset: where it is downloaded from, the source column -> canonical key map (unit, definition tag, year semantics) and the snapshot it becomes: built by the build-open-data GitHub Action (scripts/build_open_data.py, compacted by `compaction`) and committed as data/open/<dataset>.sqlite.gz with data/open/manifest.json; the server reads them from the deploy image (sha256-verified, decompressed to the temp dir) and never builds or writes open data. A column map entry lists the EXACT source spellings it accepts (`source`); the build reads the live header first and matches the spellings case-insensitively (whitespace trimmed) and never guesses: a `required` key (the identity keys) whose spellings are all absent stops that table / file (`schema_mismatch`), an optional key that is absent is recorded in the snapshot meta (`absent_columns`) and its offers are not produced, and two different live columns matching one key are `ambiguous` (stop). `fallback` spellings are read only when no `source` spelling is present. `schema_verified` records whether the map was checked against the live schema; the build re-checks it every time either way. The engine reads only the committed snapshots (vPIC: an on-demand decode, cached). `field_map`: the field offers a matched configuration makes, with the definition each source column measures and the route an offer may port to (D-4). Make aliases: data/make_canonical.json (reviewed: tozar -> canonical makes) and the spellings that normalize to them per dataset (scripts/build_make_aliases.py -> data/open_data_make_aliases.json).

eea_co2_cars.label: EEA CO2 emissions from new passenger cars (monitoring)
eea_co2_cars.year_discovery: SELECT DISTINCT year, status first; only the years present are built (2023 had no rows in [latest] on 2026-10-06); per year the final rows (status F) are preferred, the provisional rows (P) used only for a year without final rows, and the schema is read per year (SELECT TOP 1 * of that year and status)
eea_co2_cars._measure_keys: S2: only the measurements an offer (D-4 field_map) or the match (D-3 mass window: mass_running_order_kg) reads; the track widths At1 / At2 and the WLTP test mass Mt are read by neither (src/open_data/match.py, offers.py) and are no longer queried

snapshot._about: S1 / S2: one shard per year (data/open/eea_co2_cars/<year>.sqlite.gz, an oversized year split by make initial into <year>-A-L / <year>-M-Z), each verified by its own sha256; a shard stores only what the match (D-3) and the offers (D-4) read, numbers typed (INTEGER / REAL), the rows in the identity-key order, VACUUMed, no timestamp in the file: an unchanged final year rebuilds to identical bytes. K2: type_approval (T) is stored again (corroboration of the type-code key, few distinct values per shard). Not stored: registrations, the per-row status (the shard's status_used is in the manifest)

csv_years._about: K3: DISCODATA [latest] ends at 2022; the years from `from_year` that DISCODATA does not have are built from the EEA datahub's downloadable CSV. Nothing is guessed: the build reads the datahub record API (`api` + uuid + `/related`) of the `series` record (its children: one record per year and status, the year and Final / Provisional read from the child's title by `title_pattern`) and of the listed `records`, follows each record's online / download links (an index page's links are followed one level, same host), and downloads the one CSV (or zip of CSVs) it finds (none, or several without `file_pattern` choosing one: that year stops, with the links it saw). The zip is streamed to the runner disk and grouped locally exactly like the DISCODATA path (identity + measurement columns, SUM(r), the registration-weighted median / min / max per identity key), then written as that year's shard. The CSV header is resolved through the same column map plus `column_aliases`; a missing required key stops only that year. Final data is preferred over provisional for a year.

series.note: Monitoring of CO2 emissions from passenger cars Regulation (EU) 2019/631 (the series; its children are the yearly datasets)

compaction._about: E1 / G2: per (year, make spelling) one short DISCODATA query (its URL-encoded query= value <= 1,800 bytes, checked before sending; over it the measurement columns split into two queries joined locally on the identity key; still over: query_too_long): SELECT the identity and measurement columns + SUM(TRY_CAST(R AS bigint)) AS r, GROUP BY the same columns, no other alias, no MIN / MAX / AVG, no ORDER BY. The runner computes per identity key (`group_by_keys`) the registration-weighted median, min and max of each of `measure_keys` and the summed registrations; final rows (provisional per year only without final ones), the years that exist, the make values present that year whose spelling normalizes to a canonical make (data/make_canonical.json; a model-gated make only with a catalog model match); never a per-vehicle row

eea_co2_cars.schema_verified: 2018 header (reviewer, live DISCODATA, 2026-10-06); other years are read per year at build time

electric_range_km.note: not in the 2018 rows; the range column of another year's schema is added here only after it was read from that year's live schema

ademe_car_labelling.unit_rule: a column with a `unit_from_description` rule takes the unit its schema description states ("Puissance en kW", "En Kg", "Masse en ordre de marche mini (en Kg)"); a column whose description states no accepted unit is stored raw with unit `unknown` (the probe prints its p5 / p50 / p95) and yields no match key and no offer until `unit_overrides` confirms it

ademe_car_labelling.range_rule: a column with a `_max` companion: when Min != Max a single value is identified only when the match leaves one configuration, else the offer is `range` (not an offer)

tc_cvs.measured_year_note: E5: `year` is the file year (2018_en.csv -> 2018) and matching uses it (PR #56 D-3); MYR is the 2-digit measurement year, stored as `measured_year` (14 -> 2014); every CVS offer records the measured_year of its rows, and an offer whose measured_year is more than measured_year_max_age years before the target year is reference_only (it may be an older generation)

unit_overrides._about: H4: the CVS data dictionary states no unit for OL / OW / OH / WB / CW. Evidence (2018_en.csv line 154, the benchmark's Cadillac CTS 2018): OL 497 vs GM 195.5 in = 4,966 mm -> cm; WB 291 vs EEA / RDW 2,910 mm -> cm; OW 183, OH 145 on the same scale; CW 1642 -> kg. The dictionary check accepts a code whose unit an entry here confirms; the probe still prints each column's p5 / p50 / p95.

width_cm.evidence: CTS 2018: OW 183 (same scale as OL / WB)

height_cm.evidence: CTS 2018: OH 145 (same scale as OL / WB)

dictionary_check._about: every mapped CVS code must be a row of the package's data dictionary (cvs_canadian_vehicle_specifications_data_dictionary.xls) and that row must name the unit; otherwise the build stops and reports the dictionary's rows

nhtsa_vpic.label: NHTSA vPIC VIN decode (identity keys only)

eea_type_code_rules._about: K1: how the government type code (degem_nm) names an EEA configuration, per canonical make (data/make_canonical.json), as ordered rules (src/open_data/match.type_code_rule). exact_va: degem_nm (trimmed, upper case) == EEA Va. toyota_style: degem_nm (inner spaces as '-': 'ZWE211L DEXGBW' = 'ZWE211L-DEXGBW') == EEA Ve or Va with a trailing '(...)' removed ('ZWE211L-DWXNBW(1D)'). A make without rules: the type-code key is unknown and the match is unchanged. Coverage measured on 2026-10-06 against the 2020 + 2021 shards and the MILO catalog's 2020-2021 European-approval type codes: BMW 127 / 153 (exact_va), VOLVO 32 / 38 (exact_va), TOYOTA 58 / 97 (toyota_style), LEXUS 21 / 21 (toyota_style). MERCEDES-BENZ has no rule: its dotted codes ('205.040') match an EEA Va / Ve without the dot ('205040') for 29 of 202 (14 %) and with a space for 0, under the 20 % the reviewer set; not guessed.

mass_window._about: BEV / no-co2 route: a configuration whose running-order mass leaves a payload (government GVW - mass) outside this window is another configuration (another battery)

transmission_codes._about: EPA trany 'Automatic (S8)' / NRCan 'AS8': the class and the gear count (never guessed: a code that matches no pattern yields neither)
